en.topic_title: Hong Kong’s class of lawmakers join week-long Beijing study tour to learn about national development
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s Legislative Council (LegCo) has headed to Beijing for a week-long study tour to learn about China’s development, the president of the legislature has said.



Hong Kong lawmakers taking a group photo before heading off to Beijing for a study tour on July 19, 2026. Photo: Starry Lee, via Facebook.
